resources.string: Appears on the PC as a DualShock 4 and sends the phone\'s motion sensors. Set up gyro aiming in Steam Input. Leave off for an Xbox 360 controller.
Keep working when locked or in other apps
Off: the controller only works while RCWLP is on screen.
Needs the free Shizuku app, which lets RCWLP read the controller directly.
Shizuku isn\'t running. Open it and start it with Wireless debugging. This is needed again after each reboot.
Allow RCWLP in Shizuku to finish setting up.
Ready. While connected, the controller only talks to the PC. The phone ignores it, even locked or in other apps.
You can lock the phone or switch apps. The controller keeps working.\nDisconnect here or from the notification.
This phone has no gyroscope, so PS4 mode can\'t do gyro aiming.
The screen dims after 10 seconds. Tap to wake it.\nAll controller buttons go to the PC.
